name: @my-money-recap/ui
description: My Money Recap design system: tokens and React components extracted from the four recap artboards.

scripts.preview: esbuild scripts/render-screens.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --jsx=automatic --external:react --external:react-dom --outfile=scripts/preview/render.mjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/preview/render.mjs && echo 'open scripts/preview/index.html'
scripts.measure: esbuild scripts/measure.tsx --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV="\"production\"" --outfile=scripts/preview/measure.js --log-level=warning && cp scripts/measure.html scripts/preview/measure.html && echo 'open scripts/preview/measure.html'
